name: 4ntl
description: Right-click threat-intel lookups (VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB) with an inline result card.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --store && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs dist-store
scripts.demo: node scripts/build.mjs --e2e && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/demo.mjs
scripts.store: node scripts/build.mjs --e2e && node scripts/store-assets.mjs && npm run package:store
scripts.e2e: node scripts/build.mjs --e2e && node scripts/build.mjs --e2e --store && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
scripts.package:store: npm run build && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs dist-store --release && node scripts/package.mjs dist-store
